en.name: Salami, pre-packaged slices
en.summary: A sealed pack of sliced salami keeps 2 weeks from purchase in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened. Freezing is not recommended, though an unopened pack will hold 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: A whole dry salami hanging in a cool room is a different product from a pack of thin slices. Slicing and packing gives the meat an enormous amount of new surface, and modern sliced salami is usually milder and moister than a traditional hard sausage, so it lives in the fridge. Out of the fridge give it two hours at most, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F). A charcuterie board sitting out through a party is the situation to think about, even though salami tolerates it better than cooked ham does.
en.fridge: Unopened, 2 weeks from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; once opened, 3–5 days. Keep it on a cold shelf, wrapped airtight so the slices do not dry and curl, and away from raw meat. Salami is a ready-to-eat meat and carries the same Listeria consideration as any other, though dried and salted deli meats are generally presented as the safer choice for pregnant people than moist cooked ones such as ham or bologna. A white bloom on the outside of a whole salami is the intended mould culture; fuzzy blue or green growth on slices is not.
en.freezer: Freezing is not recommended. The fat in salami does not freeze cleanly — it goes crumbly and the slices separate badly — and thawed salami tastes noticeably greasier and saltier. If you freeze it anyway, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze it flat and well inside the fridge window, and use the thawed slices on a pizza or in a cooked dish rather than cold on a board.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge and use within the opened window. Never thaw it on the counter, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: A slimy or tacky film on the slices.
Fuzzy blue, green or black mould on cut slices.
A rancid, paint-like smell from the fat.
A puffed pack, or slices that have gone grey-brown through the middle.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack.
Wrap the remaining slices airtight; they dry and curl within a day.
Keep them on a cold shelf, never in the fridge door.
A white bloom on a whole salami is intended; fuzzy colour on slices is not.

faq.q: How long does packaged sliced salami keep?
faq.a: 2 weeks from purchase unopened at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 3–5 days once opened.
It is not recommended — the fat goes crumbly and the slices taste greasier. If you do, an unopened pack holds 1–2 months from purchase at −18 °C.

faq.q: Does salami need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Sliced, packaged salami does. A whole dry salami is a different product, but once it is cut it should be refrigerated too.

zh.name: 包裝莎樂美腸切片
zh.summary: 未開封的包裝莎樂美腸切片，自購買日起放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。不建議冷凍，但未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可放 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 掛在陰涼房間裡的一整條乾式莎樂美腸，和一包薄切片是不同的產品。切片與包裝讓肉多出大量新的表面，而且現代的切片莎樂美通常比傳統硬式香腸更溫和、含水量更高，所以它住冰箱。離開冰箱最多兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時最多一小時。聚會時擺一整晚的冷肉拼盤仍然要留意——即使莎樂美腸比熟火腿更耐得住。
zh.fridge: 未開封自購買日起放 4 °C 以下 2 週；開封後 3～5 天。請放冷藏層架、密封包好避免切片乾掉捲邊，並與生肉分開。莎樂美腸是即食肉品，同樣要考慮李斯特菌；不過在孕婦衛教中，乾式鹽漬熟肉通常被視為比火腿、bologna 這類含水熟肉更安全的選擇。整條莎樂美外層的白色粉霜是刻意培養的菌種；切片上長出毛茸茸的藍綠色就不是。
zh.freezer: 不建議冷凍。莎樂美腸裡的油脂沒辦法乾淨地結凍——它會變得鬆碎、切片也很難分開——解凍後的味道明顯更油更鹹。真要冷凍，未開封的包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。請平放冷凍、並在冷藏期限還充裕時處理；解凍後的切片建議放披薩或入菜，而不是冷的上拼盤。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，並在開封後的期限內用完。不要放室溫退冰，也不要二次冷凍。
spoilage: 切片表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜。
切片上長出毛茸茸的藍色、綠色或黑色霉。
油脂發出油耗味、像油漆的氣味。
包裝鼓脹，或切片中心變成灰褐色。
tips: 剩下的切片密封包好，一天就會乾掉捲邊。
放冷藏層架，不要放冰箱門邊。
整條外層的白霜是正常的；切片上有顏色的絨毛不是。

faq.q: 包裝莎樂美腸切片可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 4 °C 以下 2 週，開封後 3～5 天。
不建議，油脂會變鬆碎、口感更油。真要冷凍，未開封包裝在 −18 °C 下自購買日起 1～2 個月。
切片包裝需要。整條乾式的是另一種產品，但一旦切開也應該冷藏。
